input_fields.name: current_settings_or_help
input_fields.description: Installed navigation theme/options or relevant help reference.

input_fields.name: controlled_navigation_observation
input_fields.description: One small reversible motion on empty viewport with controller capability and observed result.

result_fields.name: navigation_mapping
result_fields.description: Version/settings-bound mapping for the tested intent and supported equivalent controls.

procedure: Record installed version/navigation settings and place the cursor over empty viewport space.
Check controller capability before trying the requested gesture; do not claim a combined input from configuration alone.
Perform one short reversible motion, observe the actual camera/selection effect, and bind it to the tested intent.
If unsupported or mismatched, return calibration_status accordingly and record Spin/Pan/Zoom tool or View-menu equivalent without claiming the original gesture.
rejection_rules: Reject calibration on selected geometry, a blocked viewport, or an unobservable result.
Do not repeatedly retry an unsupported shortcut/gesture.
Do not mark untested combinations verified from documentation alone.
